from_quote: the supreme law of the land, any thing in the Constitutions or laws of any State to the contrary notwithstanding;
rationale: The paragraph quotes, in quotation marks, the closing words of the supremacy clause as what "the laws of Congress are to be."

from_quote: In addition to the respectable authorities quoted in my first number, to show that the right of taxation includes all the powers of government
rationale: The paragraph refers the reader to the authorities on taxation quoted in Centinel's "first number," which are in Centinel.1.14 (Montesquieu's maxim that legislation follows the power of taxation).

from_quote: to all cases affecting foreign ministers and consuls; to controversies wherein the United States shall be a party; to controversies between citizens of different states,
rationale: The paragraph gives in quotation marks a close but not exact version of heads of federal jurisdiction from Article III, Section 2, Clause 1 ("foreign ministers" and "wherein" differ from the clause).

from_quote: the funds to support the troops may be granted for two years
rationale: The paragraph names the two-year limit on funds for supporting troops, which only Article I, Section 8, Clause 12 sets.

from_quote: In my first number, I stated that this body would be a very unequal representation of the several States
rationale: The paragraph restates what Centinel's "first number" said about the Senate (unequal representation, six-year terms, no rotation, a share in the executive), which is in Centinel.1.30.

from_quote: the power of pardoning, now proposed to be exercised by the president alone
rationale: The paragraph names the President's power of pardoning, which is granted in Article II, Section 2, Clause 1.

from_quote: poll taxes will be substituted, as provided for in the new plan
rationale: The paragraph refers to poll taxes "as provided for in the new plan"; the only provision naming a capitation tax is Article I, Section 9, Clause 4.

from_quote: secure the people of the benefit of personal liberty by the habeas corpus^
rationale: The paragraph names the plan's provision for the habeas corpus, which is Article I, Section 9, Clause 2.

from_quote: trial by jury for all crimes, except in case of impeachment
rationale: The paragraph names the plan's provision for jury trial of all crimes except impeachment, echoing the wording of Article III, Section 2, Clause 3.
to_quote: The Trial of all Crimes, except in Cases of Impeachment, shall be by Jury
